label: Shape Format (contextual tab)
purpose: contextual ribbon tab of the 'Drawing Tools' family; exists only while: a drawn shape is selected. Groups: Insert Shapes, Shape Styles, WordArt Styles, Text, Accessibility, Arrange, Size. Appeared on the 'shape' probe. Also appears when: a text box is selected ('textbox' probe).

children.label: ShapesInsertGallery
children.tooltip: Insert ready-made shapes, such as circles, squares, and arrows.
children.state_notes: group 'Insert Shapes'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Edit Shape
children.tooltip: Change the shape of this drawing, or convert it to a freeform shape.
children.state_notes: group 'Insert Shapes'; keytip Alt, J D, E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Draw Text Box

icon.description: Draw Text Box control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Draw a text box anywhere in your document.
children.state_notes: group 'Insert Shapes'; keytip Alt, J D, X; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: ShapeStylesGallery
children.tooltip:
Quickly add a visual style to the selected shape or line.

Each style uses a unique combination of colors, lines, and other effects to change the shape's appearance. Hover over a Quick Style in the gallery to preview your new look.
children.state_notes: group 'Shape Styles'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Shape Fill
children.tooltip: Fill the selected shape with a solid color, gradient, picture, or texture.
children.state_notes: group 'Shape Styles'; keytip Alt, J D, S F; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Shape Outline
children.tooltip: Pick the color, width, and line style for the outline of your shape.
children.state_notes: group 'Shape Styles'; keytip Alt, J D, S O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Shape Effects
children.tooltip: Apply a visual effect to the selected shape, such as shadow, glow, reflection, or 3-D rotation.
children.state_notes: group 'Shape Styles'; keytip Alt, J D, S E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Format Object...
children.tooltip: Make fine-tuned adjustments to the look of your shape using the Format Shape task pane.
children.state_notes: group 'Shape Styles'; keytip Alt, J D, O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.tooltip: Add some artistic flair by choosing between predefined text styles.
children.state_notes: group 'WordArt Styles'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Text Fill
children.tooltip: Fill the text with a solid color, gradient, picture, or texture.
children.state_notes: group 'WordArt Styles'; keytip Alt, J D, T I; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Text Outline
children.tooltip: Customize the outline of your text by choosing the color, width and line style.
children.state_notes: group 'WordArt Styles'; keytip Alt, J D, T O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.tooltip:
Turn your work into a work of art.

children.state_notes: group 'WordArt Styles'; keytip Alt, J D, T X; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Text Direction
children.tooltip: Change the orientation of text to vertical, stacked, or rotate it to the desired direction.
children.state_notes: group 'Text'; keytip Alt, J D, A X; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.tooltip: Change how your text is aligned within the text box.
children.state_notes: group 'Text'; keytip Alt, J D, A T 1; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.tooltip:
Let your text flow from one textbox to another.

Click an empty text box to link it to the current one.
children.state_notes: group 'Text'; keytip Alt, J D, C; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Alt Text
children.tooltip: Create text descriptions of objects for screen readers.
children.state_notes: group 'Accessibility'; keytip Alt, J D, A T 2; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Position
children.tooltip:
Choose where the selected object will appear on the page.

Text will automatically wrap around the object so that it's still easy to read.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J D, P O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Wrap Text
children.tooltip:
Choose how your text wraps around the selected object.

For example, you can choose to have the text continue around the object or cross right over it.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J D, T W; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Bring Forward
children.tooltip: Bring the selected object forward one level, or bring it in front of all the other objects.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J D, A F; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Send Backward
children.tooltip: Send the selected object back one level, or send it behind all the other objects.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J D, A E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Selection Pane...
children.tooltip:
See a list of all your objects.

This makes it easier to select objects, change their order, or change their visibility.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J D, A P; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align
children.tooltip:
Change the placement of your selected objects on the page.

This is great for aligning objects to the margins or the edge of the page. You can also align them relative to one another.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J D, A A; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Group
